title: feat(cli): revkit mcp channel + review rail (M2 item 3)
body:
## Summary M2 item 3 (issue #7): the `revkit mcp` stdio channel server, the `data-src` rehype plugin, and the Solid comment rail injected by the daemon at serve time. Humans comment through the rail, the MCP channel pushes those into the agent session mid-turn, and the agent replies through a tool. Stories **A2** (inline comments on any block), **A3** (threads with the agent), and **A5** (live delivery) from `docs/FEATURE-MATRIX.md`. Cites ADR-0002 (Solid), ADR-0006 (dual anchors + `data-src`), ADR-0007 (`claude/channel`) with the 2026-09-30 amendment on channel content framing / summary / reconnect, ADR-0011 (typed authors), ADR-0012 (external script tag, ready for CSP), ADR-0013 (loopback + bearer), ADR-0016 (contract + e2e + mutation), ADR-0025 (one review core). ## Channel protocol shape (verified before coding) Source of truth: (fetched 2026-09-30). - Capability key: `capabilities.experimental["claude/channel"] = {}` — presence is what registers Claude Code's inbound notification listener. Value is the empty object per the docs. - Notification method: `notifications/claude/channel`. - Params: `{ content: string, meta?: Record }`. `meta` keys must be identifiers (letters, digits, underscores). Keys with hyphens are silently dropped by Claude Code, so this PR picks `thread_id`, `path`, `lines` (all identifiers). - Reply path: standard MCP tools declared with `capabilities.tools = {}` plus `ListToolsRequestSchema` / `CallToolRequestSchema` handlers. - Transport: `StdioServerTransport` from `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` (pinned `1.31.0`, no `^`). ## What ships - `revkit mcp`: reads `.revkit/serve.json`, uses `findRunningDaemon()` (from PR #36) as the ground truth, auto-starts `revkit serve` if the flock is free. On prime it reads the daemon's current `head` (via `GET /api/threads` → `{threads, head}`), subscribes to `/events?for=agent` from that seq, and — if any open threads have a human as their last commenter — emits ONE `catchup_summary` notification telling the agent to call `threads` for details. Only NEW events fan out per-comment after that. - **Reconnect loop with bounded backoff.** On subscriber error or tool-call failure, re-runs `discover` (auto-starts a fresh daemon), verifies `/-/health`'s `instanceId`, rebuilds `DaemonClient` with the new port + token, and resubscribes from `min(lastSeenSeq, head)` so a fresh sqlite (head=0) does not stall on a stale resume point. - **Tools:** `threads` (list/filter), `reply`, `resolve`. All three proxy to the daemon's HTTP surface. `reply`'s description matches the schema's snake_case shape. - `.mcp.json` at repo root registering the server via workspace-relative `bun packages/cli/bin/revkit.js mcp` — no host paths. - `packages/cli/src/rehype-data-src.ts`: stamps every block-level hast element with `data-src=":-"` from mdast/hast positions. Wired into Astro for both site MDX and repo-doc `renderMarkdown`. - `packages/cli/src/rehype-drop-repo-doc-title.ts` (new): drops the leading `

` in HAST for repo-doc pages, so `rehype-data-src` sees the ORIGINAL source line positions. Fixes a 2-line offset that shifted 789 stamped blocks on every ADR/design/matrix page. - Solid rail island bundled with `Bun.build` at daemon startup, served at `/-/rail.js` / `/-/rail.css`. Injected via `HTMLRewriter` into every static HTML response — no Starlight override. Selection surface: floating "Comment" affordance pinned to the selection rect, `c` keyboard shortcut, Escape unwinds composer → reply → selection, composer textarea auto-focuses on open. Threads render with author kind, resolve/reply actions, keyboard-accessible. `fetchThreads` filters by every `data-src` path visible on the page so a large repo does not stream every thread's events into every rail. ## Security model - **Rail** runs same-origin under the launch-code → HttpOnly cookie flow (ADR-0013). It uses the session cookie for `/api/*` and cookie-authenticated `/events`. - **`revkit mcp`** authenticates with the agent bearer read from `.revkit/serve.json` (mode 600). Its requests carry **no `Origin` header** — a non-browser caller has no browser envelope to send, and the bearer is the credential. The daemon accepts that narrow case (Origin absent AND bearer valid); an `Origin` present must still be loopback. - **Spawned daemon runs under a minimal env allowlist** (`PATH`, `HOME`, `LANG`, `LC_*`, `NIX_*`, `XDG_*`, `TMPDIR`, `USER`, `TERM`). A hostile agent env cannot inject `LD_PRELOAD`, `NODE_OPTIONS`, private tokens, or `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` into the daemon. - **Path validation, one rule set.** `review-core` exports `anchorPathSchema` (no `..`/`.` segments, no absolute prefix, no backslash, no `:`, no control chars, 512-char cap). The rail's `parseDataSrc`, `check-dist`, and the daemon's POST /api/threads all validate against the same rule. - **Server-side revision.** The daemon computes `anchor.revision = revisionOf(source)` at thread creation and **overrides** any client-supplied value; it refuses an anchor whose file is not in the repo (`resolveAnchorSource`). The rail's rendered-text hash is discarded server-side. Re-anchoring (M2 item 5) can now trust the revision. - **Channel content framing** (ADR-0007 amended 2026-09-30). Every user-supplied field (`body`, `quote`, actor name, `path`) is HTML-escaped and whitespace-collapsed in `formatChannelPayload` before being embedded in `content`, so a body like `…` cannot forge a tag. `meta` keys are identifier-validated on emit; values are 4 KiB-capped. - **`injectRail` size cap.** 8 MiB body cap; above it the page is served without the rail and the daemon logs a warning. Fixes the previous "streams" comment which was a lie. - Nothing writes the token or the launch code to a tracked file, log or test snapshot. ## Bun HTMLRewriter workaround `HTMLRewriter.transform(...)` on Bun 1.3.13 hangs `Bun.serve` when the body is a `Bun.file()`: the file's unknown size (`u64::MAX`) overflows the pre-allocated buffer hint and the response never flushes to the socket. Tracked upstream at **oven-sh/bun#6068**. Repro: ```ts Bun.serve({ hostname: "127.0.0.1", port: 0, fetch() { const file = Bun.file("./some-large.html"); const orig = new Response(file, { headers: { "content-type": "text/html" } }); return new HTMLRewriter().on("head", { element(el) { el.append("", { html: true }); } }).transform(orig); }}); // curl http://127.0.0.1:/ → "Bun.serve: request timed out after 10 seconds" ``` Same buffer-hint workaround the issue thread recommends: `packages/cli/src/rail/injector.ts` materialises the body to a string, then rewrites, then re-wraps. Cheap for HTML (a few hundred KiB in the revkit build). When upstream fixes it we can revert to streaming; the injector's contract is unchanged. ## Tests - **MCP contract** (`packages/cli/test/mcp/contract.test.ts`) — in-memory MCP transport against a real daemon: tool schemas (names, `additionalProperties: false`, required fields), `threads` empty-state, `reply` as agent, `resolve` transitions, channel notification's exact `{content, meta}` shape, agent-authored loopback dropped. - **Real subprocess** (`packages/cli/test/mcp/subprocess.test.ts`) — spawns `revkit mcp` as a real stdio process, drives it through `initialize` + `tools/list` with `StdioClientTransport`, asserts the channel capability and the three tool names. - **Blocker 2 replay** (`packages/cli/test/mcp/replay-and-reconnect.test.ts`) — posts 2 comments, then starts the channel server: asserts 0 per-comment notifications and exactly 1 summary carrying both thread ids. Under the old whole-history replay it goes red. - **Blocker 3 reconnect** (same file) — kills daemon A, starts daemon B on the same sqlite, and asserts a new human comment reaches the agent through the reconnected client and tool calls succeed. - **SSE subscriber** + resume (`packages/cli/test/mcp/event-subscriber.test.ts`). - **Daemon bootstrap** (`packages/cli/test/mcp/daemon-bootstrap.test.ts`) — `findRunningDaemon` injected; reuse-not-duplicate, killed-then-respawn, `verifyDaemonInstance` truthy/falsy/throws. Plus `defaultRevkitBin` on paths with spaces, and `filteredDaemonEnv` allowlist. - **rehype-data-src** + **rehype-drop-repo-doc-title** unit tests. - **Injector** correctness + XSS-shape regression + 8 MiB oversize cap. - **Playwright roundtrip** (`site/tests/rail-roundtrip.spec.ts`) — boots a real `revkit serve` subprocess, selects text via `Range`/`Selection`, clicks the floating "Comment", asserts the anchor via `/api/threads` (path + `data-src`-derived lines + exact quote), pumps the event through the channel formatter, asserts channel notification `meta`, MCP `reply` → rail re-renders, resolves via the rail, `axe.analyze()` on the rendered page. Keyboard-shortcut spec covers the `c` path. **XSS regression** posts `` as a comment body and asserts it renders as text (no `` created, no handler fires). - **Built-output anchors** (`site/tests/data-src-anchors.spec.ts`) — walks `site/dist`, opens each source file the `data-src` names, asserts the block's visible text appears in the source range. Mutation-verified: restoring the old source-side strip turns the spec red. ## Mutations exercised (all verified red on demand) 1. Revert `stripLeadingHeading` no-op to source-side strip → `data-src-anchors.spec.ts` fails on every ADR/design/matrix page. 2. `parseDataSrc` returns bogus `{path, startLine, endLine}` → composer's anchor assertion in the roundtrip fails. 3. Wrong agent bearer → `POST /api/threads/*/replies` rejected 4xx (contract test). 4. Agent-authored event pumped into channel → NOT forwarded (contract test). 5. Two live-daemon `ensureDaemon` calls → spawn count stays 0 (bootstrap test — reuse-not-duplicate). 6. Killed-daemon simulation → spawn count 1, fresh state returned (bootstrap test). 7. `verifyDaemonInstance` with mismatched id → returns `false` (bootstrap test). 8. Block: 2 seeded comments before mcp start → 0 per-comment notifications, 1 summary (replay test). 9. Block: kill daemon, start new one on same sqlite → new comment reaches the agent (reconnect test). 10. `filteredDaemonEnv` with `LD_PRELOAD` / `NODE_OPTIONS` / `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` set → all dropped (env test). 11. Body over 8 MiB → rail tags NOT injected, `onOversize` called (injector test). 12. Comment body with `` → rendered as text, `` count 0, `window.__xss_fired` never set (Playwright). ## Corrections - Commit `1020c2f` claimed the reconnect path called `verifyDaemonInstance`; it didn't, though the helper was written. This PR now wires it through `cli.ts`'s `discover` (called by the channel server on failure). ## Deferred - The rail's UX is deliberately minimal (selection + composer + resolve/reply). Suggestion-mode drafts (A6), collaborative editing (A7) and rebuild re-anchoring (A8) are separate M2 items on issue #7. - WebKit is still gated behind `REVKIT_ENABLE_WEBKIT=1` (issue #19). Chromium is the CI browser. - The MCP channel is a research preview; runs under `--dangerously-load-development-channels server:revkit` until the plugin lands on an allowlisted marketplace (see ADR-0007 acceptance). ## Test plan - [x] `just lint` — 0 errors, 0 warnings. - [x] `just test` — 438 CLI + 83 review-core + 67 Playwright (Chromium) = 588 tests pass. - [x] `prek run --all-files` — every guardrails gate passes. - [x] `bun packages/cli/bin/revkit.js check-dist site/dist` — clean; every `data-src` value passes the new value check. - [x] `astro check` — 0 errors, 0 warnings. - [x] All mutations listed above verified red on demand. Refs: #7
